value.description: St. Olavs hospital, Universitetssykehuset i Trondheim, er et av Norges største helseforetak. Her jobber 11.000 ansatte hver dag for at pasientene skal få fremragende behandling.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Få ny inspirasjon til innovasjon
St. Olav-konferansen 15.-16. oktober, Clarion Hotel Trondheim
- Utforsk innovasjon, teknologi og kunstig intelligens – fra Trondheims banebrytende ultralydmiljø til frontlinjeinnovasjon og livet med en menneskelignende robot.
- Lær av ledende fagfolk- blant andre nobelprisvinner Edvard Moser og eksperter fra Karolinska Universitetssjukehuset.
- Få ny innsikt - gjennom erfaringer fra helsetjenesten og masterclasser om datadrevet planlegging og innovasjon.

pages.title: Om oss - St. Olavs hospital HF
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Hvor holder vi til?
Mesteparten av sykehusdriften er samlet på Øya i Trondheim, med betydelig aktivitet også ved Orkdal og Røros sykehus.
Psykisk helsevern er lokalisert på Østmarka, Tiller, Lian og i Orkdal, i tillegg til flere poliklinikker for barn og unge i Trøndelag.

pages.title: Kontakt oss - St. Olavs hospital HF
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Kontakt oss
Kontaktinformasjon for St. Olavs hospital
Telefon:
Sentralbord: (+47) 72 57 30 00
Sentralbordet er bemannet hele døgnet). De ulike sentrene på Øya har ikke egne telefonnummer. Kontakt aktuell avdeling.
Endring av time
Ved endring av time, kontakt avdelingen din direkte på telefon (se telefonnummer i innkallingen din).
⚠️ Endring av time skal ikke sendes som brev, e-post eller e-dialog.

pages.title: Kart over St. Olavs hospital - St. Olavs hospital HF
pages.main_text_excerpt:
St. Olavs hospital tilbyr et gratis trådløst gjestenett (wifi) for tilkobling til internett:
- Koble enheten din til trådløsenettet HMNGuest.
- Åpne nettleseren og følg veiledningen på skjermen.
- Du vil få en SMS med brukernavn og passord.
- Passord er gyldig i én uke.
Gjestenettet er tilgjengelig ved alle sykehusets lokasjoner i hele regionen. 
 
Free wireless guest network:
St. Olavs Hospital offers a free wireless guest network (wifi). The guest network is available at all hospital locations throughout the region.
- Connect your device to HMNGuest.
- Open your browser and follow the instructions.
- You will receive a password by SMS and then you can use guest network online.
- Passwords can be sent to any mobile phone with a Norwegian mobil number.
- Passwords are valid for one week at a time.

external_observations.evidence_span: P2333 = 986208860 on Q127059763 (Fondsstiftelsen Ved St Olavs Hospital)

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: St. Olav's University Hospital Google profile: rating 4/5, 219 ratings.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Had an amazing experience here. After an escooter accident I was sent here for a jaw surgery, I was operated on the morning after I was admitted. The staff here work with great levels of both confidence and kindness, excellent service across the board

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
My travelling companion (who left a review below) had a slip near the top of Grakallen and, in a freak accident, ruptured his knee. The Red Cross came up and performed an extraction, using a 6 wheeler to get him to an ambulance and then to St Olav's.

I found the staff at St Olav's very supportive and responsive. Being foreigner visitors from a cruise ship, we didn't have any sort of communications and a staff member lent me a phone so I could try and contact the cruise company.

We saw a doctor fairly quickly, in time for me to return to the ship and get my companions belongings sent to him as he had to stay behind for assessment and, a week later, surgery. Everyone we saw, although they had other patients to deal with, was very helpful and patient.

Love the statue outside the main doors.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: I fell on a nature waking and ruptured a tendon in my right knee. I received very good treatment including knee surgery and five days in recovery before being shipped back to Canada. Very pleasant and attentive staff all with an amazing knowledge of English. They turned what was a very traumatic experience and made it as comfortable as anywhere else that I could have had this accident.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: ST. Olav declined a consultation after I was referred by a dentist. They have no information on how bad the complication is, so declining a consultation doesn’t make sense to me at all. How can they make a conclusion on if the problem is bad enough without even seeing it.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Horrible experience with my fiancée delivering our baby. She needed emergency c-section due to complications likely caused by a doctor who doesnt even work there but volunteers. Then today they forgot abou us for 2 and a half hours while we sat there with a 12 day old baby. They dismissed our concerns and tod us it was our fault my fiancée got an infection in her uterus, while dr volunteer touched his face with the glove while inserting a induction balloon in my fiancée. We were there to talk about that today and they forgot about us and then wanted to convince us that the infection my fiancée had was our own fault because the hospital does not make mistakes, while having just made one. Do not go here to have your birth induced. Only reason i give 2 stars is because most nurses were awesome and 2 doctors who helped post birh were also amazing. And the entire staff of the NICU deserve raises.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: St. Olav's University Hospital is rated 4/5 from 219 Google reviews.

external_observations.evidence_span: Aggregate rating 4/5 from 219 reviews implies positive sentiment.
